items.a: You do. Repository, database and hosting are created under your name. Nothing stays with us as leverage.

items.q: Who do I talk to about details?
items.a: Directly with Andrej, who writes your software. No one in between.

items.q: What if you get sick or stop?
items.a: Everything is in your repository: code, docs and the reasoning behind decisions. The brief is written down and changes have tests, so any experienced developer can continue.

items.q: How do you use AI in development?
items.a: AI agents write the routine code under my supervision. I own architecture, security and review every change before it ships. That's how one person covers what used to take a team.

items.q: What if I end the partnership?
items.a: The software keeps running, because it's yours. You only pay hosting and any AI services directly to their providers. When you want to add something, get in touch.
You write through the form, we reply within one business day and set up a 15-minute call. No obligation, no preparation needed.
An audit takes one to two weeks. An MVP 4 to 8 weeks. Bigger projects follow a written plan you get before we start.
We don't bill by the hour. An audit has a fixed price up front. Projects get a written quote after the audit. Monthly work is agreed per scope.
Yes. Code, tests and docs live in your repository. Continue with us or with anyone else.
